Targets are known-source anchors, not an exhaustive bibliography. A hit measures retrieval of a known source only; it does not measure precision or coverage of all valid answers.

groups.mechanism: Standard interface for interchangeable fungible token balances, transfers, approvals, and delegated spending.

hard_negatives.reason: Token interface for non-fungible assets with unique ownership, a close token-standard comparator but a different asset model.

phrases.query: standard interface for fungible tokens with transfer, approve and allowance

groups.mechanism: An exact, IO-aware attention kernel that tiles computation to reduce high-bandwidth-memory traffic using on-chip SRAM.

hard_negatives.reason: KV-cache paging and memory management for serving, not the exact IO-tiled attention-kernel mechanism.

groups.mechanism: A cheaper draft model proposes multiple tokens for parallel verification by a larger model, with correction preserving the sampling distribution.

hard_negatives.reason: Exact IO-aware attention-kernel optimization, not draft-token verification and exact correction sampling.

groups.mechanism: Dynamic multimodal key-value cache allocation guided by cross-modal attention entropy.
